2. Body: Elongated shape, metallic bronze-green iridescence, and characteristic pale elytral spots are all clearly visible and correct.
3. Limbs/Anatomy: Six legs are present, slender, and correctly jointed. Segmentation (head-thorax-abdomen) is distinct.
The Router was not too lenient; the features are unambiguous.
